messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: Re: link to website for the book Applied Statistical Modelling for Ecologists broken
parts:
Dear Spiloptila, dear everybody else who has been wondering the same thing,

sadly, this link has never been unbroken ---- rather, our publisher hasn't yet been able to create the website, even though we submitted all the contents two months ago. They keep promising things will get better soon.

In the meantime, you can download all code plus the bonus extra chapter on the Nmix model from Ken's website: https://kenkellner.com/ASM/

Many apologies to everybody who has had the same problem ! Once Elsevier manages to set up their own, proper website for the book, we will give an announcement on this list.

Best regards  --- Marc & Ken
